title: The Book by the Pond
lines: Gus took a good book to the pond.
Mom sat with him on the soft grass.
Gus stood by a wood post, back from the pond.
A duck came to look at his book.
Gus shook his book at the duck.
His good book fell in the pond!
Gus got a thin stick from the grass.
The stick was short and did not reach.
Then Mom took a hook from her bag.
She tied the hook on to the thin stick.
Gus stood with Mom and got the book back.
It was wet, so he took it home.

questions.ask: Where did Gus stand to see the pond?
questions.listenFor: By a wood post, back from the pond. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: Why did the thin stick not work at first?
questions.listenFor: It was short and did not reach. So Mom tied a hook on to it.

questions.ask: The story says Gus shook his book. What does shook mean? Show me with your hands.
questions.listenFor: Moved it fast, back and forth. Line five. Acting it out is the check that they really have the word.
